block.guhs.karen.lore: Plankmika's computer wife. Has an opinion about everything, mostly: no.

block.guhs.vruchthuis_dak.lore: The leafy little crown on top of the fruit house.
block.guhs.vruchthuis_raam.lore: A round little window. For when you want to see who is nibbling on your house.
block.guhs.vruchthuis_deur.lore: A round door with a porthole.
block.guhs.bellenblaas.lore: A toy for your guhs: they chase the bubbles. Right-click blows a cloud of them.
block.guhs.spooklantaarn.lore: Gives a spooky green light. Standing or hanging, never scary. Well, a little.
item.guhs.knabbelburger.lore: Krusty bun, chonky patty. The secret ingredient stays secret.
item.guhs.kwallenjam.lore: Jam made from Crumb Jellies. Still glows a little in your tummy.

gui.guhs.einde2_sponsguh_wezens.karen.1: Karen: "That was almost a good plan. Almost."
gui.guhs.einde2_sponsguh_wezens.karen.3: Karen: "Sigh. I should have married a toaster."

gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.sponsguh: Rarity: One of a kind: the fry cook of The Krusty Nibble in Bikini Bottom
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.sponsguh: A square block of holey cheese with guh ears, square pants and a tie. He lives in a nibble chorus fruit deep under the outer islands, bakes the best Nibble Patties of the Guh End and is always ready. When he becomes your buddy he walks along with you, soaks up spilled water and cheese sauce, bakes you a Nibble Patty every day and laughs so contagiously that your guhs start hopping. Sneak and click: then he stays home and waits for you.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.gerrit: Rarity: One of a kind: the snail of Spongeguh Cheesepants
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.gerrit: A snail with guh eyes on stalks and a pink shell with a blue swirl. Says nyeg where a cat would say meow, and means all sorts of things by it. When he becomes your little snail he crawls calmly after you and leaves a little trail of slime. Pet him for a nyeg, sneak and click and he stays where he is.
I'm ready! I'm ready! ...Ready for what again, nyeg?
Is nibble sauce an instrument?
Hello, I like nibbles! And keep your pawsies off my nibble safe, nyeg.
Daddyyy! I want a new bow. And a pony. A guh pony!
Howdy! Hands off my helmet, that's where I keep my air. Hi-yah!
Nyeg.
Sigh. Yes, I am a Mika. No, I don't shove anyone. I'm far too tired for that.
Ah, a little friend of Squidmika's. Have you admired my jacket yet? Real velvet. Squidmika has none.
I went to Mika college! One day that recipe will be mine. ONE DAY!
Pawsies at ten and two and do NOT panic. Oh Neptuguh, why do I do this job...
Kneel before King Neptuguh! ...Is my crown on straight? There's such a draft on my head.
Be a little kind to each other, nyeg. That goes for you too, Daddy.
I'm Dennis. I only shove to order.
... *heavy breathing through a diving helmet* ...
Hop on, little chonk. I'll swim you anywhere.
GRAAAH! ...Sorry, did I scare you? Want a snuggle? We're about to sing a song.
MY LEG! ...Oh no, it's still on. Nyeg.
Boo! I am the Flying Guhchman! Have you seen my dining sock anywhere?
EVIL! ...Oh, you're just a passerby. To the invisible boatmobile!
Mermaid Guh, your porridge is getting cold. And no, I haven't seen your belt.
